description.describe_ch: 敏銳的觀察、審視、收集、分析、並做出決策判斷為出色偵探的必要條件，受訓者經由質與量的方法訓練後，將能具備基本的偵查能力，敏於發現問題並嘗試採取適切的解決方式，並在實地場域操練下出師。本課程目的在介紹辯證式邏輯與田野調查法，訓練學員如何進行獨立思考，學習「問對問題」與「情境解析」。本課程特別強調讓學生在實務中練習問題分析能力，並學會問題表達、脈絡分析，以培養解決問題能力。將藉由弱勢族群和偏鄉地區之移動(Mobility)分析和重新認知，嘗試透過共享經濟(Sharing economics)以及資源可移轉性（transferability）的視角，探討如何透過資源整合與政府資源導入，創造得以永續經營的基本民行之ESG解方。
description.describe_eh: The purpose of this course is to introduce dialectical logic and train students on how to engage in independent thinking and apply it to essay and case writing. This course particularly emphasizes practicing problem analysis skills in practical scenarios and learning to ask the right questions and analyze contexts to cultivate problem-solving abilities. The conditions of sensitive observing, reviewing, collecting, analyzing, and making the right decisions are the requirements to be an outstanding detective. The participants will become an expert by the qualitative and quantitative training who have the basic detective ability and easy to find the appropriate method to solve problems. The course will combine three disadvantaged groups (elders, disables, and children) and discuss their basic demand of mobility, integrate multiple resources and government by the sharing economics and resource transferability to create a sustainability of mobile service for the disadvantaged groups.
